fusions.name: Gnawing Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of gnawing slivers 4 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to every enemy caught in it.

fusions.name: Famine Ball
fusions.desc: Hurls a curled ball of scales that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts for 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Swarm Shell
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 8 seconds. For 12 seconds a swarm fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4s.

fusions.name: Stripped Field
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher at all times.
